MY_MODULES.ActionHud.title: Action HUD
MY_MODULES.ActionHud.hint: Show the action HUD for this client.
MY_MODULES.ActionHud.alwaysShowCharacter: Always show my character’s action HUD
Players can show the action HUD for their assigned character when no owned token is selected, even if the character has no token in the scene.
MY_MODULES.ActionHud.combineHotbarHint: Dock the action tabs above your macro slots in one frame. Turn this off to restore the separate HUD.
MY_MODULES.ActionHud.move: Drag to move the action HUD. Double-click to return it to the hotbar.
MY_MODULES.Cursors.Own: Show my cursor to the others
MY_MODULES.DeathSaves.Name: Private death saves
MY_MODULES.DeathSaves.Hint: Choose the GM account that receives death saves rolled by players. Only the player who rolls and this GM account can see the result in chat.
MY_MODULES.DeathSaves.SelectGM: Choose a valid GM account for private death saves in the module settings.
MY_MODULES.DeathSaves.Journal:
Make death saving throws from your character sheet. Only you and the GM account selected in the module settings can see the result in chat. This applies even if you skip the roll dialog.

Foundry tracks successes and failures on your character sheet and hides the counters from other players who view it. A natural 1 counts as two failures. Your allies decide whether to help based on what they see and hear in the fight.
MY_MODULES.Levels.FullList.Name: Show every level
MY_MODULES.Levels.FullList.Hint: The level navigation under the scene name lists every level, without scrolling.
MY_MODULES.Variants.Style.Name: Variants at their levels (GM only)
MY_MODULES.Variants.Style.Hint: How a level's variants show in the level navigation. Click: this level only. Shift-click: every level that has the variant.
MY_MODULES.Levels.Dropdown.Name: Levels as a dropdown
MY_MODULES.Levels.Dropdown.Hint: Under the scene name only the current level shows; a click on it folds the list of every level out and in.
MY_MODULES.Names.Format.Name: Format of random token names
MY_MODULES.Names.Format.Hint: For figures with name tables. {name} is the drawn name, {actor} the prototype token's name, for example "{name} ({actor})".
